title: Instrument Detective
description: Listen for a mystery instrument, tap the matching picture, and build a tiny concert band.
artDirection: Kawaii storybook music-detective world with a warm paper stage, friendly owl guide, colorful tactile instrument art, and soft sparkle feedback.
interactionModel: Listen to six mystery instrument sounds, then choose one of three large illustrated instruments; unlock a free-play concert.
feedbackModel: Forgiving replay and gentle nudge on misses; correct choices glow, play their solo, and join the band.
credits: QLOBE Kids; GPT Image 2 and Krea 2 artwork; shared QLOBE instrument recordings.
